name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
value: US, Mexico, Bolivia lose elimination (17 Nov)
summary: PAHO confirmed on 17 Nov that the US, Mexico and Bolivia lost measles elimination; CDC confirms six US deaths in 2026
state: PAHO announced on 17 Nov that the United States, Mexico and Bolivia have lost measles elimination status after 12 months or more of continuous transmission (ITV; The Star, Malaysia). CDC confirmed six measles-related US deaths in 2026, double the 2025 toll, with cases above 5,000 for the first time since 1991 (GMA News, 13 Nov). Loss of elimination status meets Watch; searches on 21 Nov found no multi-country surge with clearly rising deaths that would cross the Alert line.
for_you: Two doses of MMR vaccine give strong protection. Check your and your children's vaccination records with the NHS or your GP, and follow UKHSA or CDC advice before travel to areas with outbreaks.
rubric_hit: Watch: loss of elimination status in the US, Mexico and Bolivia (PAHO, 17 Nov)

sources.title: ITV News — Measles is no longer considered eliminated in the US and Mexico

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
